title: Osmantic/ODS
description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

title: Shelpuk-AI-Technology-Consulting/kitty-bridge
description: Universal LLM bridge for AI agents. Use Claude Code with MiniMax, Codex with GLM, or Gemini CLI with OpenRouter — one command, any provider. Works with coding agents, OpenClaw, Hermes, and others.

title: JeanDes-Code/sneq-narrative-system
description: Narrative-state engine for AI-narrated games (TTRPGs, AI Game Masters, agent campaigns). Stops the LLM from forgetting or forking canonical reality. TypeScript, ESM, SQLite + sqlite-vec, multi-provider router. V2 alpha.

title: JetBrains/junie
description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: MrWangJustToDo/MyAgent
description: MyAgent — AI coding agent for the terminal. Edits code, runs commands, and plans tasks locally or through a remote server — in the CLI, a Chrome extension, or a browser playground. Three orthogonal planes (Workspace · LLM · Session) let you mix local & remote however you want. Built on TanStack AI

title: phuetz/code-buddy
description: Local-first AI coding agent for the terminal. 64 LLM providers, 30 of them free or local $0, with auto-failover. 220+ tools, a peer-to-peer fleet, and a desktop app. No API bill required.

title: yauntyour/cell.cpp
description: A lightweight AI coding agent written in modern C++26. Connect to OpenAI or Anthropic, chat with your codebase, and let the LLM read, write, edit, and execute — all sandboxed.

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: CowDogMoo/squad
description: Squad runs unattended AI agents, defined as markdown plus YAML, against any LLM provider in bounded, cost-capped tool loops - locally or on Docker, Kubernetes, or EC2.

title: icetomoyo/KodaX
description: A lightweight AI coding agent that actually works. KodaX is modular, zero-config, and supports multiple LLM providers out of the box. Use it as a CLI tool or npm library—with session memory, parallel execution, and agent teams. Written in TypeScript.

title: Spitfire-Products/nexus-cortex
description: A headless, multi-provider AI agent harness — embed it as a library, script it from the CLI, or run it as a stateful agent server. One orchestrator drives every major LLM provider.

title: oh-my-harness/senza-studio
description: Web app to customize AI agents via natural-language conversation, example library, or direct code editing. Built on llm-harness-runtime + Senza SDK.

title: adecubed/gigamail
description: Mail for AI agents ( and humans). MCP server giving Claude (or any agent) safe, permission-controlled access to email (Microsoft Graph + IMAP), calendar and your knowledge files. Two-phase confirmation for sends, audit log, local index. No built-in LLM: your agent brings the intelligence.

title: NoorQureshi/SploitAgent
description: An open library of security skills for AI agents - pentest, bug bounty & defense. 85+ trigger-loaded skills across 16 domains (web, API, cloud, AI/LLM, AD, mobile, and more). Load into Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, or a local model.

title: 99percentgrip/agent-vesper
description: Agent Vesper is a pure-Rust AI agent harness that remembers you across conversations. It provides a provider-neutral runtime where any LLM provider can plug in — today it ships with the Z.ai GLM adapter, tomorrow any provider can join with zero TUI or runtime changes.

title: agentd-dev/source-code
description: A minimal, MCP-native, cloud-native AI agent runtime. One small static Rust binary runs one agent: hand it an instruction and one LLM endpoint, and it runs the agentic loop — think, call a tool, observe, repeat — until the task reaches a terminal status or a new event wakes it.

title: DemoMacro/office-open
description: Create Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) from plain JSON or fully typed APIs — generate, parse, and patch. Built for AI agents, LLM tool-calling, and hand-written code alike; no Microsoft Office required, opens in every major office suite.

title: Snaehath/autonomous-local-system-agent
description: A model-agnostic AI coding agent supporting any local (Ollama) or cloud LLM with native tool calling over JSON-RPC stdio.

title: prive8/openclaw-memory-system
description: Four-layer memory architecture for OpenClaw (or similar) AI agents - backed by an Obsidian vault, hardened against cron-fragility patterns that silently fail. Ships with a self-bootstrap prompt: paste it into an LLM and it sets up the whole system.

title: goruck/home-generative-agent
description: AI agent for Home Assistant — talk to your home, create automations in plain language, analyze cameras with face recognition, and get proactive anomaly alerts. Cloud LLMs or fully local via Ollama.
